messages:
arun: Kicking off staged rollout for r-2026.03.24-rc1 -> 3 waves (5% each). deploy id=20260324-rc1. Will ask for stop/go at each wave.
deploy-bot: Wave1 (5%) deployed to ap-south. variant=r-2026.03.24-rc1. logs: https://redwood.internal/deploy/20260324-rc1
tia: Quick smoke: p50/p95 fine, but embeddings tail in ap-south p99 jumped +280ms after wave1. seeing ~1.2% 5xx on embed path. dashboard: https://dash/reports/6265432100
devops-lee: I see GC churn on embed pods and a couple of restart events. recent image build uses new tokenizer lib.
qa-miguel: Canary tests: embed-compat test 2/20 failed (timeout), others passed.
arun: Can we hold wave2? I want a short triage. deploy-bot will await manual go.
ops-bot: safety-latch set by tia: hold_on_errors>0.5%, max_wave_increment=0, notify=#eng-releases.
tia: Suggest isolating embedding traffic to previous variant in ap-south while leaving other routes on rc1. That would be a regional split. Thoughts?
devops-lee: Agree. We can route embed-service->v2026-03-19, textgen stays on rc1. Quick change should be safe.
arun: If split fixes it, we proceed elsewhere. If not, we soft-rollback region.
deploy-bot: Executing route-split: embeddings -> v2026-03-19, other routes -> r-2026.03.24-rc1. Applied to ap-south.
tia: Post-split: embed 5xx dropped to 0.2% and p99 returned near baseline. Good sign.
qa-miguel: Re-running embed canary after split: 20/20 pass now.
arun: Okay, we'll keep ap-south pinned for embeddings and continue to hold wave2 globally. Vote to proceed with wave2 to other regions but keep embed-split enabled in ap-south? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:
devops-lee: +1 proceed for other regions, keep embed pin in ap-south.
tia: +1 but require a follow-up: add a preflight check for tokenizer lib memory delta.
qa-miguel: +1. Also add a quick rollback script to automate pinning per region.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-322 created (owner: devops-lee). Summary: tokenizer lib caused memory regression in embedding workers; mitigation: regional embed pin, route-split, add mem-delta preflight.
arun: I'll update release notes: "ap-south: embeddings pinned to v2026-03-19 due to memory regression observed in r-2026.03.24-rc1; other services remain on rc1. Investigating tokenizer lib changes."
tia: Follow-ups: (1) add memory regression test in CI, (2) schedule rollback drill for staged rollouts, (3) revert tokenizer lib change on a test branch.
arun: For now, deploying wave2 to na-east and eu-north but with safety latches enabled. Deploy-bot, please proceed with wave2 to those regions only.
deploy-bot: Wave2 (5%) started -> regions: na-east, eu-north. Will pause and wait for go.
ops-bot: Note: automated rollback timer set for ap-south only if embed pin not applied within 20m. Human ack cancels timer.
darun (typo correction): arun: ack, cancel auto-rollback for ap-south. We'll keep the stop/go channel open for 24h.
arun: Thanks all. Will file a postmortem stub in #postmortems and link INC-2026-322.
